children: Mitsubishi Electric demonstrated that frequency dispersion in GaN transistors can be significantly suppressed using GaN substrates. The company says this could contribute to smaller, higher-performance, lower-power high-frequency equipment.
GaN substrates suppress transistor frequency dispersion
The demonstration addresses a source of unstable operation and could support smaller, lower-power high-frequency equipment.

This is an early-stage technical milestone; the release does not report commercialization or financial impact. Further validation and deployment in products or customer systems would be needed to establish a larger catalyst.
